newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Signing of pact between Qatar and Bahrain stalled due to difference over several points in draft agreement prepared by four-state Gulf Arab committee.
- Saudi Arabia spent 4.2 billion riyals on development plans in 26 years, minister says.
- Lawyer of British nurses accused of killing their Australian colleague to pressure the victim's family for mercy.
- Around 700 million riyals in 1997 budget allocated for water projects in the kingdom, agriculture minister says.
- Saudi British Bank posts 465 million riyals in net profits in 1996.
- Saudi Arabia imported baby food for 443 billion riyals in four years.
